adversarial_cases: Empty I: both total sum and image cardinality are zero, hence conclusion 0≤0.
Negative U and negative summands are allowed: summing the per-member bound multiplies both sides by the same positive nonempty-fiber cardinality, without a sign-dependent inequality.
Empty fibers are never cancelled; only c in the actual finite image is considered.
The key target C need not be finite; only the image and each domain fiber are used.
The proof partitions the finite sum exactly once by key and introduces no multiplicity.
